cond_0001.intro: The Senior Optical Engineer at [Company name masked] will be part of an engineering team developing novel laser components and systems and transition them into products. Incumbent may act as a technical lead, while at the same time contributing to the analysis, modeling, design, prototyping and testing of laser components and systems. As individual contributor, this person will be responsible for requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, interface with critical component suppliers, planning and execution of integration and test. Additionally, this person will be solving complex problems requiring deep understanding of material science and laser technology and excellent problem-solving skills across the company and contribute to IP, publications and business development.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Design, build and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Develop alignment procedures.
Individually responsible for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for the laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Responsible for evaluation of failure modes, conducting root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions for the company products with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Interact effectively and efficiently as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers, write reports and contribute peer reviewed publications and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management and the customer as required
Attend appropriate engineering, customer or business meetings
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Masters Degree in Engineering or related technical field
Laser optical system design experience
Scripting and/or interfacing Zemax with Matlab for design automation
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Experience with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Fluency in technologies and application domain
Optical/laser related industry background

Working alongside colleagues across the company, this person will support requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, coordination with critical component suppliers, and planning and execution of integration and test. This role also involves collaborating on complex problems that require deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and contributing to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0027.responsibilities:
Collaborate on optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Work with the team to design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Help develop alignment procedures.
Share responsibility for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units, working closely with colleagues on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Coordinate on evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Work effectively as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers; contribute to reports, peer-reviewed publications, and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and customers as needed
Participate in relevant engineering, customer, or business meetings
cond_0027.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing, or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Fluency in technologies and application domain
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation; laser optical system design experience
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python, or C++
Experience using Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Experience with multimode, single mode, and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Master's Degree in Engineering or related technical field
Optical/laser related industry background
Ability to lead a technical group independently

cond_0036.intro:
[Company name masked] develops mid-infrared laser light technology for government and commercial markets, including defense and security, life sciences, and industrial process control.
The Senior Optical Engineer will work as part of an engineering team developing novel laser components and systems and transitioning them into products. The role may involve acting as a technical lead while contributing to analysis, modeling, design, prototyping, and testing of laser components and systems. Working alongside colleagues across the company, this person will support requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, coordination with critical component suppliers, and planning and execution of integration and test. The role also involves collaborating on complex problems that require deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and contributing to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0036.responsibilities:
Coordinate optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Work with the team to design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing; help develop alignment procedures
Share responsibility for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects, working closely with cross-functional partners
Collaborate on evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Work effectively as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers; write reports and contribute to peer-reviewed publications and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and the customer as required
Attend relevant engineering, customer, or business meetings
cond_0036.requirements:
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio. Working knowledge of both sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation. Laser optical system design experience preferred
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment. Experience with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Masters Preferred) or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience (optical/laser related industry is preferred)
Fluency in technologies and application domain
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

Optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab

Working knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation

Background in mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Some programming experience: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++

Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 5 years of experience in an optical/laser related field

Laser optical system design experience
Familiarity with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Familiarity with electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Familiarity with technologies and application domains relevant to the role

This person may serve as a technical lead while also contributing to analysis, modeling, design, prototyping, and testing of laser components and systems. Working alongside colleagues across the company, this person will support requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, coordination with critical component suppliers, and planning and execution of integration and test. This role also involves collaborating on complex problems that require deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and contributing to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0225.responsibilities:
Collaborate on optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Work with the team to design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Help develop alignment procedures.
Share responsibility for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units, working closely with colleagues on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Coordinate on evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Work effectively as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers; contribute to reports, peer-reviewed publications, and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and customers as needed
Participate in relevant engineering, customer, or business meetings
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing, or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Fluency in technologies and application domain
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation; laser optical system design experience
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python, or C++
Experience using Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Experience with multimode, single mode, and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Master's Degree in Engineering or related technical field
Optical/laser related industry background
Ability to lead a technical group independently

The Senior Optical Engineer will own a broad scope of engineering work — leading the development of novel laser components and systems and driving them through to products. You will act as a technical lead while taking direct responsibility for analysis, modeling, design, prototyping, and testing of laser components and systems. You will own requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, supplier interfaces, and the full arc of integration and test. You will also drive solutions to complex problems requiring deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and contribute to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
Execute optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Own the development of alignment procedures.
Take direct responsibility for major portions of complex development projects
Lead laser and optical work for laser systems and sub-systems from early concepts through product prototypes to initial production units, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Own evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Drive effective collaboration across a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers; author reports and contribute to peer-reviewed publications and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and the customer as required
Attend appropriate engineering, customer, or business meetings
cond_0251.requirements:
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio. Working knowledge of both sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation. Laser optical system design experience preferred
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks.
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment. Experience with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Masters Preferred) or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience (optical/laser related industry is preferred)
Fluency in technologies and application domain
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

cond_0260.intro: [Company name masked] develops mid-infrared laser light technology for government and commercial markets, including defense and security, life sciences, and industrial process control. The Senior Optical Engineer will own the development of novel laser components and systems and drive their transition into products. You will act as a technical lead while taking direct responsibility for analysis, modeling, design, prototyping, and testing. You will also lead complex problem-solving that draws on deep knowledge of material science and laser technology, and contribute to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0260.responsibilities:
Own optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab.
Design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Develop and own alignment procedures.
Take direct responsibility for major portions of complex development projects.
Lead laser and optical development for laser systems and sub-systems from early concepts through product prototypes to initial production units, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects.
Own evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects.
Execute effectively as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, and directly with customers and suppliers; write reports and contribute peer-reviewed publications and invention disclosures.
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and the customer as required.
Attend appropriate engineering, customer, or business meetings.
cond_0260.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing, or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Laser optical system design experience
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python, or C++
Experience using Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Experience with multimode, single mode, and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Fluency in technologies and application domain
Master's Degree in Engineering or related technical field
Optical/laser related industry background

cond_0381.intro: The Senior Optical Engineer at [Company name masked] will be part of an engineering team developing novel laser components and systems and transition them into products. Incumbent may act as a technical lead, while at the same time contributing to the analysis, modeling, design, prototyping and testing of laser components and systems. As individual contributor, this person will be responsible for requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, interface with critical component suppliers, planning and execution of integration and test. Additionally, this person will be solving complex problems requiring deep understanding of material science and laser technology and excellent problem-solving skills across the company and contribute to IP, publications and business development.
cond_0381.responsibilities:
Optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Design, build and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Develop alignment procedures.
Individually responsible for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for the laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Responsible for evaluation of failure modes, conducting root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions for the company products with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Interact effectively and efficiently as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers, write reports and contribute peer reviewed publications and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management and the customer as required
Attend appropriate engineering, customer or business meetings
cond_0381.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Working knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation
Experience aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Background in mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Some programming experience: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks, including for opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Background in semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 5 years of experience in an optical/laser related field
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Laser optical system design experience
Familiarity with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Familiarity with electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Familiarity with technologies and application domains relevant to the role
Ability to lead a technical group independently
Master's degree in Engineering or related field

As an individual contributor, this person will be responsible for requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, coordination with critical component suppliers, and planning and execution of integration and test. Additionally, this person will be solving complex problems requiring deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and will contribute to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0421.responsibilities:
Optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab.
Design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing. Develop alignment procedures.
Individually responsible for major portions of complex development projects.
Serve as the laser and optical lead for laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects.
Responsible for evaluation of failure modes, conducting root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects.
Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and customers as required; write reports and contribute to peer-reviewed publications and invention disclosures.
Communicate clearly in written and oral form with internal teams and external contacts as required.
Attend relevant engineering, customer, or business meetings.
cond_0421.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio, including both sequential and non-sequential simulations
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Hands-on experience in development, prototyping, testing, or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and their interactions in a system
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation; laser optical system design experience
Programming skills in Matlab, LabVIEW, Python, or C++
Experience using SolidWorks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology, and measurement equipment
Experience with multimode, single mode, and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Fluency in relevant technologies and application domains
Master's Degree in Engineering or related technical field
cond_0421.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

The Senior Optical Engineer will work as part of an engineering team developing novel laser components and systems and transitioning them into products. The role may involve acting as a technical lead while contributing to analysis, modeling, design, prototyping, and testing of laser components and systems. Working alongside colleagues across the company, this person will support requirement flow-down, electro-optical design, coordination with critical component suppliers, and planning and execution of integration and test. The role also involves collaborating on complex problems that require deep understanding of material science and laser technology, and contributing to IP, publications, and business development.
cond_0468.responsibilities:
Coordinate optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab
Work with the team to design, build, and align optical bench setups for prototype and production design verification testing; help develop alignment procedures
Share responsibility for major portions of complex development projects
Serve as the laser and optical lead for laser systems and sub-systems ranging from early concepts to product prototypes to initial production units, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects, working closely with cross-functional partners
Collaborate on evaluation of failure modes, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions for company products, with emphasis on optical and opto-mechanical aspects
Work effectively as part of a multi-member, multi-function team, as well as with customers and suppliers; write reports and contribute to peer-reviewed publications and invention disclosures
Communicate clearly (written and oral) with manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and the customer as required
Attend relevant engineering, customer, or business meetings
cond_0468.requirements:
Expert level knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio. Working knowledge of both sequential and non-sequential simulations and scripting and/or interfacing with Matlab for design automation. Laser optical system design experience preferred
Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment. Experience with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Masters Preferred) or related technical field with a minimum of 5 years of experience (optical/laser related industry is preferred)
Fluency in technologies and application domain
Ability to lead a technical group independently
U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD Secret-level security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

Optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax and Matlab

Proficient at aligning and integrating complex optical table setups
Understanding of mechanical, thermal, electrical, and optical designs and components, and their interactions in a system to meet performance requirements
Programming skills: Matlab, Labview, Python or C++
Experience using Solidworks.
Hands-on experience in the development, prototyping, testing or transfer to production of complex EO/Mechanical systems
Appreciation and practice for engineering process rigor appropriately applied based on product/process maturity
Knowledge of semiconductor laser technology, laser and optical design and modeling, optical components and materials from UV to IR, optical metrology and measurement equipment. Experience with multimode, single mode and polarization maintaining fiber
Laser packaging experience
Solidworks to create opto-mechanical designs and test setups
Knowledge of electronic test equipment for time-domain and frequency-domain measurements, control theory, and signal processing

Fluency in technologies and application domain
Ability to lead a technical group independently
